verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents automation rules for error assignment and discard rules. Nothing in the pack shows those automations can be versioned, have their change history reviewed, or be rolled back. The release-tracking items cover the user's app releases, and the Data Access API 'Versioning' page covers API versioning; neither applies to versioning automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
